Welcome to another enlightening episode of *Upanishad Ganga*! In this episode, we explore one of the most profound and timeless philosophical concepts from the Upanishads - **The Theory of Karma and Rebirth.** This captivating episode delves into the intricate workings of karma (actions) and their consequences, illustrating how our past deeds shape our present and future lives.
